create.name: Jacoby Ballard
create.bio:
Jacoby Ballard (he/they) is a yoga and meditation teacher based in Salt Lake City, Utah, who brings the heart practices of yoga and Buddhism together with social justice work. He has taught for about twenty years, beginning in New York, where in 2008 he helped found Third Root Community Health Center in Brooklyn as a cooperative linking wellbeing and community organising. Since 2006 he has led a dedicated yoga class for queer and trans people, and his work was recognised by Yoga Journal with awards in 2014 and 2016. In A Queer Dharma, published in 2021, he reads the Brahma Viharas of lovingkindness, compassion, joy and equanimity through a queer lens.

His classes are playful and searching, rooted in classical philosophy but applied to present-day questions of identity, belonging and repair. He teaches weekly online yoga for LGBTQ students and an online meditation sangha, sells recorded practice packs on the yamas and niyamas, and mentors yoga teachers who want to find their own direction. He also trains studios and meditation communities in diversity, equity and inclusion, speaks at colleges, and is one of Kripalu's Visionaries, leading online forgiveness series and a New Year retreat for queer and trans participants there.

courses.title: Sanctuary: Spiritual Grounding for Queer and Trans Folks
courses.description: A New Year retreat at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, for queer and trans participants only, co-led with yoga educator and artist Ro Grace. Days combine yoga, creative movement and lovingkindness practice with time to explore how queerness shapes a spiritual life.

courses.title: The Heart of Forgiveness: Expanding Vulnerability and Nobility for Freedom
courses.description: A four-week live online series on Monday evenings through Kripalu, taking one direction of forgiveness each week: towards yourself, from those you have hurt, towards those who hurt you, and towards wider collective sorrows. Each session comes with a meditation recording to use until the next.

courses.title: Queer & Trans Yoga – Virtual
courses.description: A weekly Sunday evening yoga class on Zoom, held by and for LGBTQ people as a warm and embodied community. Payment is on a sliding scale, and community sponsors help anyone who cannot pay.

courses.title: Meditation Sangha – Virtual
courses.description: An hour-long weekly meditation group on Zoom on Wednesdays. Jacoby introduces the practice, the group sits together for around half an hour, and members then talk about what came up.

courses.title: 5 Yamas and 5 Niyamas Asana Pack
courses.description: Ten recorded hour-long yoga classes, each built around one of the ethical observances in Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, from non-harming and truthfulness to contentment and surrender. Each practice links the theme to breath, posture and everyday choices.

courses.title: Coaching Session
courses.description: One-to-one coaching calls for yoga teachers, studio owners and mission-led organisations. Typical topics include fair pay for teachers, making classes and trainings more inclusive, and repairing working relationships.
